But we need to list all files in temporary directory. We can use find with path="/tmp"? But find expects path relative? It says path defaults to ".". It can be any path. So we can call find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will return all items. But we want to list all files available there right in the terminal. We can use find to get list. Then we can use cat? But we just want to list names. find returns list of file names. That should be fine. Let's do find with path="/tmp" and name=None.
